newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ sees short term risk on upside.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ sees short term risk on upside.

text.p: The Reserve Bank on Friday warned that the balance of risks for inflation one year ahead remained on the upside, but looking past the next year it was comfortable its assessments were broadly in balance.
Among the risks it identified the housing market as the main cause of short term risk.
The bank projected underlying inflation to peak at 2.7 percent in September 1996, and then to fall to 2.1 percent by March 1997.
